simple.meaning: טֶנֶא (ṭeneʼ) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a basket (of interlaced osiers).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Deuteronomy 26:2. The surrounding context includes altar, priesthood, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to טֶנֶא (H2935) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: טֶנֶא (ṭeneʼ) / H2935 is traced through Deuteronomy 26:2, Deuteronomy 26:4, Deuteronomy 28:5, Deuteronomy 28:17 with generated occurrence evidence.

firstOccurrence.englishText: that you shall take some of the first of all the fruit of the ground, which you shall bring in from your land that Yahweh your God gives you. You shall put it in a basket, and shall go to the place which Yahweh your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there.

timeline.evidenceText: that you shall take some of the first of all the fruit of the ground, which you shall bring in from your land that Yahweh your God gives you. You shall put it in a basket, and shall go to the place which Yahweh your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there.

definitions.full: H2935. tene טֶ֫נֶא noun masculine Deut 28:5 basket (Late Hebrew טְנִי is a large metal vessel) — absolute טֶ֫נֶא 26:4 , טֶ֑נֶא 26:2 ; suffix טַנְאֲךָ 28:5 , 17 ; in all a receptacle for products of soil (in last two || מִשְׁאֶרֶת ).
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root probably meaning to weave;
